props.name: items
props.description: The items on the reel. Composed `children` work too.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way a straight reel moves. Ignored when there is a path.

props.name: hoverSpeed
props.description: Speed while the pointer is over the reel; `0` pauses it.

props.name: playOnView
props.description: Hold at the start until the reel scrolls into view, and replay each time it does.

props.name: flow
props.description: How items are sent down the course.

props.name: cycles
props.description: Passes through the items before resting. Unset runs forever.

props.name: rest
props.description: Milliseconds to wait once the course clears, between groups and after `cycles`.

props.name: loop
props.description: Go again after `cycles`. `false` stops for good.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade items out at the edges: the ends of a straight reel, or the ends of an open path. `true` fades over 48px; a number sets the width.

props.name: path
props.description: An SVG path `d` for the items to follow. Closed with `Z`, it loops.

props.name: viewBox
props.description: The coordinate space of `path`, scaled to fit the reel. Without one the path is in the reel's own pixels.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Travel a path from its end to its start.

props.name: orient
props.description: `auto` turns items to face along the path; `none` keeps them upright.

props.name: showPath
props.description: Draw the path as a faint dashed line under the items.

props.name: drawable
props.description: Press and drag to draw a new path.
